# POKROV

Last updated: 2026-07-21

POKROV is an app-first VPN product for Android and Windows. The public beta flow is simple: install the app, start 5 days free without a card, connect from the app, then manage duration, devices, recovery, and support through the cabinet.

## Canonical URLs

- Public site: https://pokrov.space/
- Install help: https://pokrov.space/install/
- Android app page: https://pokrov.space/android/
- Windows app page: https://pokrov.space/windows/
- Pricing and checkout continuation: https://pokrov.space/checkout/
- Cabinet: https://app.pokrov.space/
- API: https://api.pokrov.space/
- Connection delivery host for explicit manual recovery: https://connect.pokrov.space/
- Public release files: https://github.com/Kiwunaka/pokrov/releases

## Product facts

- Brand: POKROV
- Public beta platforms: Android and Windows
- Trial: 5 days free, no card required
- Telegram reward: +5 days after explicit account linking and channel check
- Starting total: up to 10 days (5 trial days + 5 Telegram reward days)
- Paid plans: from 99 RUB for 30 days; up to 5 devices depending on plan
- Billing model: one-time paid access periods, no automatic renewal in the public flow
- Free fallback after trial: monthly limited base mode
- Support: cabinet, support bot, news channel, and support email
- Release files: Android APK and Windows files are distributed through official surfaces and GitHub Releases

## Pricing summary

- Free start: 0 RUB, 5 days, no card required
- Start on 30 days: 99 RUB, 30 days, 1 device
- 1 month: 249 RUB, 30 days, up to 5 devices
- 3 months: 699 RUB, 91 days, up to 5 devices
- 6 months: 1199 RUB, 182 days, up to 5 devices
- 9 months: 1399 RUB, 273 days, up to 5 devices
- 12 months: 1644 RUB, 365 days, up to 5 devices

## Release honesty

The current public beta is outside-store for Android and Windows. Do not describe POKROV as store-published, a stable production release, trusted-signed on Windows, production-mature beyond the evidence on the public site, or ready for Russian-origin public reachability claims.
